{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "andrewtoth",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACKed, but raised objections on comment removal, log phrasing, and SetDirty freshness semantics, plus a question on scope; all addressed by author"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACKed and reACKed citing code maintainability benefits and elimination of invalid cache states"
    },
    {
      "login": "ptrinh",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "tested coins fuzz targets and unit suites on the branch without issues and confirmed invariant consistency"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3105640231",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "removing a relevant comment loses valuable context",
      "quote": "Why remove this comment? It's still relevant and provides valuable context.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author restored the comment above the new SetDirty call",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3107401207"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3107401207",
      "status_by_quote": "Restored above the new `SetDirty` call"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3105647133",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "removing 'changed' from the log message conflates committing deleted outputs with committing only new outputs",
      "quote": "The `changed` adjective could be left here. Existing transaction outputs that are deleted are `changed`. The log now can be conflated with committing only new transactions outputs.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added 'changed' back to the log message",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3107400760"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3107400760",
      "status_by_quote": "Added `changed` back"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3105652703",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Why was this code touched here?",
      "quote": "Why is this touched here?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it was for symmetry with SetDirty",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3107400710"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3107400710",
      "status_by_quote": "Just for symmetry with `SetDirty`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3105667838",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "SetDirty could unexpectedly clear freshness on an already fresh entry",
      "quote": "Why do we want to set a fresh entry to not-fresh? If an entry is fresh, it should stay fresh until cleaned or erased as before.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added an Assume check to prevent silently clearing FRESH",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3107400554"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3107400554",
      "status_by_quote": "Added `Assume(!pair.second.m_fresh || fresh)` so the API can't silently clear FRESH, thanks"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:4134896528",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Thanks for picking this up.",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4164135258",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "Post-change the invalid states cannot be represented. This change is a code maintainability benefit, because any code change could potentially break the conventions. It also results in slightly simpler code.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "CCoinsCacheEntry",
        "BatchWrite",
        "SetDirty",
        "SetFresh",
        "AddFlags"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4787121241",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Tested the coins fuzz targets on this branch with no crashes, OOMs, sanitizer errors, or hits on the new BatchWrite logic_error; confirmed invariant consistency.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "coins_view",
        "coinscache_sim",
        "BatchWrite",
        "SetDirty",
        "IsDirty"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5566315263",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "No issues. A net reduction in complexity around coins view flags",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "coins view flags"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of rebased branch with SpendCoin tightening and cleanup",
      "id": "c:5920884279"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added the missing question from andrewtoth (rc:3105652703), which was answered by l0rinc. The PR is waiting on reviewer follow-up after the author rebased and applied cleanups."
}
